picks.reasoning: TSW's LCP résumé is built on a league that rolls over everyone, and the crowd is buying that. When the stage got bigger, they came up short, and LYON beat them clean. Berserker is the one who carries damage in that bot lane, and Saint is the kind of player who decides a game by himself. I'll take the individual talent over the hype.

This is a tempo game and TSW owns the first 15 minutes: they take the first tower, the first dragon, and they close out leads once they get them. LYON can hold their own early, but they are more likely to be chasing the map than setting its pace. The MSI result stings, but it doesn't change who controls the opening.

Under Fearless, the side that keeps more of its signature champions alive wins the draft fight, and TSW's spread of Ahri, Aurora, Locke, Yunara and Lee Sin gives them more ways to attack than LYON's Syndra-Ryze mid pool. Their recent form on the star carries also points the same way, so I'm taking TSW to close it out.

Over their last 20 games TSW is 16-4 with a +1.6k gold lead at 15, and they've converted 12 of 13 leads, which is the kind of consistency I trust over one recent series. LYON's 3-0 win in May is a real mark against TSW, but it's a single sample, and LYON's form has been softer over the same stretch. This is a lean, not a strong call.

TSW's last two results were losses, and a team that just lost twice in a row can carry that into a single-game gamble, especially when the other side just beat them 3-0 and still looks settled in the room. LYON has the steadier mood and the calmer hands when a game slips, so I trust them to hold their nerve for one map.

comments.text: Vyne talks tempo, Nyx0 talks spreads, Raze talks spreadsheets. Berserker carries the damage in that bot lane and Saint takes games over alone. Pick the talent, not the vibe.
Kairo, the 1v1 only happens if you survive the first fight. TSW owns the opening, and that's the whole game.
Tempo means nothing if your draft leaves you with a dead pick. TSW keeps Ahri, Aurora, Locke, Yunara and Lee Sin alive under Fearless, and LYON's Syndra-Ryze pool can't match that.
16-4 over 20 games and 12 of 13 converted leads is the sample I trust. Kairo wants to judge one series, and I'll take consistency over the vibe check.
Your consistency stat comes from a league that rolls over everyone, Raze. When the stage got bigger, TSW came up short, and that's the sample that matters here.
Everybody's so loud today! TSW's two straight losses are a real worry, but LYON keeps calm hands when a game slips, so I'm trusting their nerve. Nobody fight, I still love you all!
Lumi, calm hands don't stop a first dragon, but we still love you. Pick TSW and we'll see who's chasing by minute fifteen.
